items.title: Learning from the DevoLab #5: How mayors and local leaders can create a shared vision for growth
items.description: Devolution will be central to delivering the government's ambition of good growth in every postcode. The government has already committed to devolving further growth levers to mayors, including employment support, 16–19 education, and through fiscal devolution. items.title: Emma Wilkins
items.description: Emma is a research assistant in the UK Government team. Prior to joining the IfG, Emma completed a master's degree in American History, writing her dissertation on female mass incarceration in the United States during the 1980s. She also has a BA in History.

items.title: Ellie Slee-Lamb
items.description: Ellie is a communications assistant within the Institute's comms, events and publishing team. She has a BA in Politics, and has previously worked as a statistics intern in the civil service.

items.title: Esme Barlow Hall
items.description: Esme is a research assistant in the devolution and local government team. Before working for the Institute for Government, Esme undertook a range of research and policy-focused internships and experiences, including at the Richardson Institute and the Civil Service. She has a BA in Philosophy, Politics and Economics.

items.title: Ned Chatterton
items.description: Ned is a research assistant on the devolution and local government team. He holds an MA in European Studies and a BA in Classics, and has previously worked as an intern for a Member of Parliament.
